_comment: Reviewed dependency findings that can't be fixed in this repository.
security/run.py turns a matching finding into a NOTE (still listed in the report, with the reason).
Matching is exact: a duplicate is accepted only while Cargo.lock has exactly these versions,
an advisory only for this package version. Any change -> it's a warning again.
Entries that no longer match anything are reported as stale, remove them.
Re-review on every dependency bump; never add first-party code here.

cpufeatures.reason: RustCrypto stable line (aes, sha2, argon2) vs chacha20 0.10 from rand 0.10

dashmap.reason: btleplug: jni-utils pins dashmap 5, btleplug itself uses 6

hax-lib.reason: libcrux 0.0.11: core-models uses hax-lib 0.3, libcrux-intrinsics 0.4 (verification annotations, no runtime code)

rand_core.reason: RustCrypto stable + dalek use rand_core 0.6, libcrux/rand 0.10 use 0.10

syn.reason: proc-macros only (compile time): syn 1 from wezterm-dynamic-derive (ratatui termwiz backend, all-features graph), syn 3 from async-trait (btleplug), the rest on syn 2

windows-sys.reason: Windows only: ring (snow default resolver) pins 0.52

RUSTSEC-2026-0173.reason: unmaintained, not a vulnerability; compile-time proc-macro only (libcrux -> hax-lib-macros 0.3), no runtime code, no fixed version upstream
